finding.title: Growth shifted toward Service and Other and Intelligent Cloud while Product and More Personal Computing lagged
finding.observation: In the consolidated product/service view, Service and Other grew 22.7% in FY26, reached 80.5% of revenue, and gained 320 bps of mix, while Product grew only 1.2%, fell to 19.5% of revenue, and had a -0.1% two-year CAGR. In the segment view, Intelligent Cloud grew 29.7%, reached 41.5% share, and contributed 62.9% of revenue growth, while More Personal Computing declined 1.1% and lost 311 bps of share; Productivity and Business Processes grew 15.9% with a 42.2% share.
finding.why_it_matters: Consolidated revenue growth of 17.8% was not broad-based across the disclosed revenue categories and segments, with increasing reliance on faster-growing areas and weakness in Product and More Personal Computing.
investigation_questions: What disclosed components within Service and Other and Intelligent Cloud explain their FY26 growth?
What explains Product revenue stagnation and the More Personal Computing decline?
How did the FY26 changes in revenue and segment mix affect reported profitability?
